dogecoin.text:
Trump is on the $DOGE train with his new line of Dogecoin-branded T-shirts

Unlike Bitcoin, which he’s apparently holding onto, these shirts fit right into his hype game 😁

To make things more interesting, Elon Musk also joined the trend with a tweet about Dogecoin. https://t.co/s6HWCW3Q5K

4. DOGE started as a joke - Dogecoin was created in about 2 hours as a parody of Bitcoin, using a Shiba Inu meme. Its creators never imagined it would reach billions in market cap or that Elon Musk would become its biggest fan.
